title: Croatian Beef Skewers with Nutty Crunch
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish from Croatia, featuring marinated beef skewers with a nutty crunch.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine beef, Croatian spices, salt, and pepper.
3. Thread beef onto skewers, leaving space for even cooking.
4. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
5. Meanwhile, mix walnuts and panko breadcrumbs in a small bowl.
6. Once skewers are cooked, brush with olive oil and sprinkle with walnut-panko mixture.
7. Serve skewers hot, garnished with additional walnuts if desired.
